source_audits.finding: A-001 inherited handoff target binding gap
A-001/A-002/A-003 post-write refreeze and deterministic gate failures
A-001 category hierarchy/path search behavior lost during enhancement replacement

controls.procedure: Resolve PR #671 and verify repository, issue, PR, refs and exact material SHA before accepting or publishing the handoff.
controls.expected: Only a fresh package bound to issue #615 / PR #671 at the current material candidate is eligible.
controls.observed: Historical inherited and stale certificates are rejected; the current refreeze subject is material head 02c9d97b1c38e6a3944555c6ef5a66c9e2faf512.

controls.procedure: Replay npm run format:check as part of the CRITICAL exact-head validation after the final material edit.
controls.expected: Formatting gate exits zero before lint, typecheck, tests and build proceed.
controls.observed: Delivery V2 run 35551454448 on 02c9d97b1c38e6a3944555c6ef5a66c9e2faf512 passed format check and continued through the remaining CRITICAL validation steps.

controls.procedure: Execute the registered Chrome route scenarios at desktop and mobile after the filter-action reflow regression is present.
controls.expected: No accidental horizontal overflow and keyboard-visible route content remain operable.
controls.observed: Statement visual run 35551454360 on 02c9d97b1c38e6a3944555c6ef5a66c9e2faf512 passed the admin institutions, financial indexes and legacy remuneration registered scenarios, including desktop/mobile overflow checks.

controls.procedure: Run the registered categories-interface Chrome scenario on a seeded nested category; enter a query derived only from an ancestor/path segment and compare the announced result count with direct name+path matches.
controls.expected: The child category remains visible from path-only search and contextual parents do not inflate the direct-match result count after the legacy enhancement is retired.
controls.observed: Statement visual run 35551454360 on exact material head 02c9d97b1c38e6a3944555c6ef5a66c9e2faf512 passed categories-interface; 63 registered visual coverage executions passed overall.
